description: This file contains a PHPUnit test class for testing the EmailConfigurationDao within the OrangeHRM's Admin plugin. It includes setup, a test for retrieving email configuration, and a test for saving email configuration with various parameters.

classes.name: EmailConfigurationDaoTest
classes.description: PHPUnit test case for testing EmailConfigurationDao CRUD operations within the OrangeHRM Admin plugin.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the EmailConfigurationDao instance and loads test fixture data before each test.

methods.name: testGetEmailConfigurationGeneralInformation
methods.description: Tests retrieving the email configuration, expects an instance of EmailConfiguration.

methods.name: testSaveEmailConfigurationGeneralInformation
methods.description: Tests saving a complete email configuration with various SMTP settings and verifies the saved data.
